title: Moveup
description: x-moveup is a button inside an x-move container: a click swaps the item holding it with the item above (one row up in a grid, the previous item in a list) and fires wb:reorder on the container. x-move wires it; it reads no attributes.

wb:reorder.description: Fired on the container after a swap.

_metadata.derivedFrom: move.js moveup() — every property here is one the behavior reads
